summary: Checked the change that replaces the in-app Safety Assessment with the SACOparentsAlign Family check-in. Backend quick recheck: 17/17 pytest passed. Every old /api/safety-assessment/* route returns 404/405. /api/next-steps/safety and /api/verify/court-report/x return 404. /share/mine and /secure-docs/sent list no safety documents. The complete-report PDF says 'Safety step: not started' and never 'Flagged'. Frontend: all requested flows pass. Redirects work (/safety-assessment->/help; /next-steps/safety, /case-settings, /plan-options->/). Consent screen and login work. There is no Safety Assessment/Screen entry on the portal home, Self Journey, Court Ordered page, /summary, /readiness or /progress (with the Main menu open). Family check-in card and 'Quick check-in' point to the same address: SA-DEMOCK -> https://sacoparentsalign.com/check-in?case=SA-DEMOCK, a fresh unlinked user -> https://sacoparentsalign.com, target=_blank, no align_ref and no .online host. The footer link is on public and signed-in pages. The pre-share dialog (Summary share) shows the approved notice and its checkbox does not mention 'six points'. /what-professionals-see has no old claims and carries only the two step lines. Neutral block: a fresh user with a legacy level-1 row sees the exact neutral note plus an 'Open Family check-in' link on the invite card; there is no email input and no safety/flag/hotline words. Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow on the portal journey, /who-can-see-my-information or /privacy-notice. Remaining issue: the old 'Safety Screen' is still described on two public pages linked from the footer, /methodology and /accessibility.
